name: vgs_physics_ai_contextual_dual_expert_v2
status: pre-registered before context-v2 held-out event and mechanics evaluation
purpose: A separate, context-enhanced follow-up after gated_v1 showed no EBIV improvement under uniform injected noise. It must not overwrite or relabel any historical VGS result.
test_window_boundary: The v1 gated experiment used hot-plate fractions 0.2 and 0.8 (and an earlier pilot used 0.5). Context-v2 reserves fractions 0.35 and 0.65 and new test noise seeds. No v2 training, model choice, threshold choice, or mechanics choice may read these windows.

model.context_features: 100 event-centred 5x5 time-surface lags: past/future x same/opposite polarity, with a fixed 5 ms lookahead. No frame accumulation is used.
model.physics_features: 14 causal VGS-derived descriptors plus a Platt-calibrated VGS continuous score; these are not the historical full VGS implementation.
model.gated_context_dual_expert: 117-64-16-1 reliability gate over 14 physics descriptors, 100 context descriptors, two expert probabilities, and their absolute disagreement
model.feature_state_rule: The causal physics state is updated from the raw chronological stream. Context descriptors use exactly a declared 5 ms finite lookahead; the output remains a timestamp-aligned subset of original events.

optimization.model_selection: highest macro mean validation ROC-AUC over fixed validation-selection subsets; deterministic tie order: gated_context_dual_expert, physics_context_mlp, context_ai_expert

threshold.rule: On validation only, choose the largest threshold whose mean per-case source recall is at least 0.98 and whose minimum per-case source recall is at least 0.95. The threshold is then frozen for held-out event/EBIV/EBOS evaluation.

mechanics_metrics: source-derived reference-map EPE or flow difference
evaluation.primary_reporting: mean and sample standard deviation over three frozen training seeds; no best-seed selection

label_boundary: Source-recording events are controlled-corruption proxy positives and can include native sensor noise. Injected events are known proxy negatives; neither label is absolute clean/noise ground truth.
reference_boundary: EBIV source-event maps and EBOS clean-source flow maps are reference solutions, not independent physical ground truth.
negative_result_boundary: gated_v1 is a retained diagnostic ablation. Context-v2 is a new method and its results must be reported separately; it may not be described as a retroactive improvement of gated_v1.
